sections.title: 2. Benchmark workloads (deterministic)
sections.text:
Inputs are generated from seeded hashes; no network or wall-clock external services in the harness definition.

| BW-DIG-001 | Descriptor digest | Random descriptor payloads | throughput | P8 |

| BW-SNAP-001 | Snapshot restore | Storage chaos fixtures | recovery success | P8 |

sections.title: 3. Measurement protocol
sections.text:
1. **Bind environment:** record git commit, PHP/Dart/Composer versions, CPU model, OS kernel, and a machine fingerprint hash in the raw sample artifact.
2. **Warmup:** discard first *W* iterations (default *W*=3) per workload; configurable but recorded.
3. **Samples:** collect *N* timed samples (default *N*=30) per workload; store raw timings and input digests.
4. **Statistics:** report median, p95 and max per workload on the same fingerprint only.
5. **Regression gates:** P8 may set regression thresholds **only** after calibration on a matching fingerprint; absolute cross-machine timing is **forbidden** as a PR blocker before P8 calibration.
6. **Artifacts:** raw output JSON is SHA-256 digested; receipts cite digest, not prose summaries.

sections.title: 4. Downstream notification
sections.text: P2–P10 item specs must cite `RL-*` rows they implement or tighten. New limits require a new `RL-###` row here before code claims a number.
